tenderSchedule.locationName: KFD ACF Territorial Sub Division Office Ramadurga

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Upload all the documents as specificatied in Sub Section 3 of uloaded tender document (Refer Section 3.1 to 3.13, Page No. 05 & 06 & 08)
Annual turnover details For Last three Financial year (2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) Upload turnover certificate certified by Charted Accountant.
Line of credit including E-tender Indent No & addressed to undersigned not less then 30% of the Tender amount received from any Nationalized Bank
For address proof any copy of Adhar Card, Voter ID, Telephone bill within two months, Ration Card, Bank Pass book, ID issued any Corporation/TP to be uploaded).

Work done certificate of seedlings grown, Nursery works and Nursery maintenance work carried out in last 5 years duly signed by Deputy Conservator of Forests Or any Other Equalant District level Officer. (Nursery Raising Related)
A copy of List of Skilled, semi skilled, un skilled labours including EPF & ESI details to be uploaded) along with copy of Registration in Labour Department, EPF & ESI Registration Certificate.
Details of goods carriage vehicle, labor service, list of machineries & materials, equipments owned by the contractor.
A copy of GST Number Registered under GST act
Income tax return filed documents for the year 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 & 2025-26 to be enclosed
Contractor should be registered as Forest Contractor in forest department for the year 2026-27
